checks.proposed_rule:
problem: The deck spins while it fans out.
implementation: Hold the wheel orientation and angle during the fan-out; open the spread only, then start the spin.
use_when: Fan-out entrances of ordered card rings.
avoid_when: A brief that asks for a spinning entrance.
checks.acceptance_test: Fan-out curl within ±1.5 /s of the reference and owner review of 1.2-1.6 s side by side.

checks.evidence: Approach 3.0-3.65 s: occlusion proxy 0.15 vs 0.58; frames around 3.5 s show near-edge-on pages while the wheel axis turns.
checks.hypothesis: [reference-interpretation; unvalidated] The reference keeps faces visible while bottom-right pages grow and overlap; our transition rotates the axis through an edge-on pose.
checks.proposed_rule:
problem: Re-orienting a card wheel can pass through an edge-on pose and empty the frame.
implementation: Move the camera toward the face side of the rim first and turn the axis while faces stay visible; check every frame of the transition.
use_when: Transitions between two views of the same card structure.
avoid_when: A deliberate flip or wipe.
checks.acceptance_test: Approach occlusion proxy >= 0.45, no frame with coverage < 0.1 between 3.0 and 3.65 s, owner review.

checks.hypothesis: [implementation; unvalidated] Climax wheel tilt (x 0.5 rad) and position are a hand fit with too little elevation.
checks.proposed_rule:
problem: Riffle pages read upright instead of lying back.
implementation: Raise the viewing elevation over the rim (more wheel tilt) and centre the passing point; compare page aspect (width/height) to the reference.
use_when: Rolodex-style climaxes.
avoid_when: Pages must face the viewer frontally.
checks.acceptance_test: Median on-screen page aspect in 3.7-4.1 s within 15 % of the reference, owner review.
